task: Using both arms, grasp each cup: the right hand grasps the source cup (which contains the beads) and the left hand grasps the empty receiver cup. Lift both cups off the table, bring the pouring lip of the source cup over the mouth of the receiver cup, and tilt the source cup so that beads pour into the receiver cup. Pour the amount that was requested for this episode (ctx.pour_target_beads, within one bead), then bring the source cup back down to upright while both hands keep holding their cups. Keep the receiver cup upright, do not drop either cup, do not let the cups touch, and spill as few beads as possible. The environment decides success; this round's priority is that beads actually leave the source cup and land in the receiver, because the last three rounds poured nothing at all.
